airspace.zh: 印度依《2021年無人機規則》管理：無人機須在數位天空平台登記取得識別碼，空域分為綠、黃、紅區，在黃區與紅區飛行須事先取得許可；每次飛行前都要在平台上查詢限制。
airspace.en: India's Drone Rules 2021: drones must be registered on the Digital Sky Platform with a unique identification number; airspace is divided into green, yellow and red zones, and flights in yellow and red zones need prior permission. Check Digital Sky before every flight.

title.zh-Hant: 泰姬瑪哈陵深度空拍：陵墓、花園、河流與光
title.en: The Taj Mahal in Depth: Tomb, Garden, River and Light

tagline.zh-Hant: 30分鐘，從亞穆納河的晨光到河岸上的生命
tagline.en: 30 minutes from dawn on the Yamuna to life on its banks

zh: 清晨，亞穆納河上的第一道光。
河對岸的白色圓頂，是泰姬瑪哈陵。
en: First light on the Yamuna.
The white dome across the river is the Taj Mahal.

zh: 接下來約三十分鐘，從六個角度認識它：
歷史、花園、石頭、河流、光線，與河岸上的生命。
en: For the next half hour we look at it from six sides:
its history, its garden, its stone, its river, its light and the life on its banks.

zh: 這裡是印度北方邦的阿格拉，
亞穆納河右岸的白色陵墓，泰姬瑪哈陵。
en: This is Agra, in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh:
the white tomb on the right bank of the Yamuna is the Taj Mahal.

zh: 它是一座陵墓，
莫臥兒王朝第五位皇帝沙賈汗，為妻子而建。
en: This building is a tomb,
built by Shah Jahan, the fifth Mughal emperor, for his wife.

zh: 1631年6月17日，慕塔芝・瑪哈去世，
當時她正生下第十四個孩子。
en: Mumtaz Mahal died on 17 June 1631,
giving birth to their fourteenth child.

zh: 同一年，沙賈汗下令建造這座陵墓；
en: That same year Shah Jahan commissioned the tomb;
work began in 1632.

zh: 工程動員兩萬多名工匠與工人，
來自布哈拉、敘利亞、波斯與南印度。
en: More than 20,000 workers and artisans took part,
from Bukhara, Syria, Persia and southern India.

zh: 還有俾路支的石匠與義大利工匠；
宮廷建築師烏斯塔德・艾哈邁德・拉合里主持。
en: Stone cutters came from Baluchistan and artisans from Italy;
the court architect was Ustad Ahmad Lahori.

zh: 在她逝世十二週年時舉行了第一次紀念儀式。
en: The first ceremony was held on 6 February 1643,
on the twelfth anniversary of her death.

zh: 陵墓主體在1648年完成，
整個園區據信到1653年才全部完工。
en: The mausoleum was finished in 1648;
the whole complex is believed to have been complete by 1653.

zh: 長鏡頭慢慢推近：白色大理石的立面。
近看，大理石上鑲嵌著各色寶石與半寶石。
en: A slow push through a long lens: the white marble front.
Up close, precious and semi-precious stones are set into the marble.

zh: 沿著河往上游約兩公里，
是紅砂岩建成的阿格拉堡。
en: About two kilometres upstream
stands Agra Fort, built of red sandstone.

zh: 後來兒子奧朗則布廢黜沙賈汗，
把他軟禁在阿格拉堡。
en: Shah Jahan was later deposed by his son Aurangzeb
and held under house arrest in Agra Fort.

zh: 從堡裡，他看得見河彎另一頭的泰姬瑪哈陵。
en: From the fort he could see the Taj Mahal across the bend of the river.

zh: 1666年沙賈汗去世，
葬在妻子身旁。
en: Shah Jahan died in 1666
and was buried beside his wife.

zh: 泰姬瑪哈陵是一整組建築，
不只是一座白色圓頂。
en: The Taj Mahal is a whole ensemble,
not only a white dome.

zh: 從上面看，一切沿著南北中軸線對稱排列。
en: From above, everything is laid out symmetrically along a north–south axis.

zh: 南端是以大理石為主的正門，
樣式呼應陵墓本身。
en: At the south end is the main gateway, built mostly of marble,
echoing the tomb itself.

zh: 大門與陵墓之間是「四分花園」，
每一區又分成十六塊下沉花圃。
en: Between gate and tomb lies a fourfold garden,
each quarter divided into sixteen sunken beds.

zh: 花園正中央是抬高的大理石水池，
五座噴泉與一道倒影池在中軸線上。
en: At the centre is a raised marble tank
with five fountains, and a reflecting pool on the axis.

zh: 陵墓兩側各有一棟紅砂岩建築，
其中一棟是清真寺。
en: Two red sandstone buildings flank the tomb;
one of them is a mosque.

zh: 另一棟幾乎一模一樣，稱為「迴響」，
沒有壁龕，主要為了對稱。
en: Its almost identical twin, the jawab or "answer",
has no mihrab; it is there for symmetry.

zh: 藝術史學者埃巴・科赫認為，
整個配置象徵塵世與來世。
en: Art historian Ebba Koch reads the plan
as a picture of earthly life and the afterlife.

zh: 正門標誌著兩者之間的過渡。
en: In that reading, the great gate marks the passage between the two.

zh: 白色大理石會隨時間變色：
清晨帶點粉紅，月光下則泛著金色。
en: The white marble changes through the day,
pinkish in the morning and golden in moonlight.

zh: 往西過了阿格拉堡，
是城裡的主麻清真寺。
en: West, beyond Agra Fort,
is the city's Jama Masjid.

zh: 阿格拉至今仍是一座生活中的城市，
老城就在清真寺周圍。
en: Agra is still a living city;
the old town spreads around the mosque.

zh: 約有五百萬人造訪泰姬瑪哈陵。
en: In the year 2022–23
about five million people visited the Taj Mahal.

zh: 他們沿著同一條中軸線走進來，
看見的，是三百多年前設計好的那一眼。
en: They walk in along the same axis
and see the view that was designed over three centuries ago.

zh: 這是一部用尺寸與石頭看泰姬瑪哈陵的影片。
en: This film looks at the Taj Mahal through its measurements and its stone.

zh: 整個園區坐在河岸一座平台上，
長約三百公尺、高八點七公尺。
en: The complex sits on a riverside platform
about 300 metres long and 8.7 metres high.

zh: 陵墓本身立在高六公尺的台基上，
台基每邊九十五點五公尺。
en: The tomb stands on a plinth 6 metres high,
95.5 metres along each side.

zh: 四角各有一座尖塔，
每座都超過四十公尺高。
en: A minaret rises at each corner,
each more than 40 metres tall.

zh: 主圓頂高二十三公尺，
坐在十二公尺高的鼓座上。
en: The main dome is 23 metres high,
on a drum 12 metres tall.

zh: 頂端的尖頂還有九點六公尺；
整座建築高約七十三公尺。
en: The finial adds another 9.6 metres;
the whole building is about 73 metres tall.

zh: 白色大理石來自拉賈斯坦邦的馬克拉納。
en: The white marble came from Makrana in Rajasthan.

zh: 長鏡頭繞著陵墓的一角。
正午的陽光從高處照下，白色最亮。
en: A long lens circles a corner of the tomb.
The noon sun stands high and the white is at its brightest.

zh: 周圍紅色的砂岩，
則來自北方邦的法特普希克里。
en: The red sandstone around it
came from Fatehpur Sikri, in Uttar Pradesh.

zh: 大理石上鑲嵌了二十八種寶石與半寶石，
有些來自很遠的地方。
en: Twenty-eight kinds of precious and semi-precious stone
were inlaid in the marble, some from far away.

zh: 玉與水晶來自中國，綠松石來自西藏，
青金石來自阿富汗。
en: Jade and crystal from China, turquoise from Tibet,
lapis lazuli from Afghanistan.

zh: 藍寶石來自斯里蘭卡，
紅玉髓來自阿拉伯。
en: Sapphire from Sri Lanka,
carnelian from Arabia.

zh: 為了運送材料，工人築了一條十五公里長的土坡道，
用牛和大象拖運。
en: To bring the materials in, a 15-kilometre earthen ramp was built,
with oxen and elephants hauling the loads.

zh: 上游的阿格拉堡同樣是紅砂岩，
城牆長二點五公里。
en: Upstream, Agra Fort is also red sandstone,
its walls 2.5 kilometres long.

zh: 兩座建築隔著亞穆納河相望，
一紅一白，標出了這座城市。
en: The two face each other along the Yamuna,
one red, one white, marking out the city.

zh: 泰姬瑪哈陵蓋在亞穆納河彎的岸邊，
面河的一側沒有圍牆。
en: The Taj Mahal stands on a bend of the Yamuna;
the side facing the river has no wall.

chapter.zh: 河、花園與變黃的大理石
chapter.en: A River, a Garden and Yellowing Marble

zh: 其他三面圍著有雉堞的紅砂岩牆，
整個園區約十七公頃。
en: The other three sides are enclosed by crenellated red sandstone walls;
the complex covers about 17 hectares.

zh: 對岸是月光花園，
和陵墓完全對齊。
en: Across the river is Mehtab Bagh, the Moonlight Garden,
perfectly aligned with the tomb.

zh: 這座方形花園大約三百公尺見方，
面積約十公頃。
en: The square garden measures about 300 by 300 metres,
some 10 hectares.

zh: 雨季時，花園地面會局部淹水；
它由印度考古調查局管理。
en: In the rainy season the ground is partly flooded;
the garden is run by the Archaeological Survey of India.

zh: 考古調查局認為，
亞穆納河本身也被設計進天堂花園的意象。
en: The Survey has suggested that the Yamuna itself
was woven into the design as one of the rivers of Paradise.

zh: 但河與空氣也帶來傷害：
污染讓大理石逐漸泛黃發褐。
en: But river and air have also done harm:
pollution has turned the marble yellow-brown.

zh: 酸雨，以及包括馬圖拉煉油廠在內的污染源，
都被認為是原因之一。
en: Acid rain and pollution, including from the Mathura refinery,
are among the causes.

zh: 1997年依最高法院指示，
設立「泰姬梯形管制區」。
en: In 1997, following Supreme Court directives,
the Taj Trapezium Zone was set up.

zh: 管制區面積一萬零四百平方公里，
對排放有嚴格標準。
en: It covers 10,400 square kilometres
and sets strict emission standards.

zh: 河谷地下水位下降，也引起結構上的擔憂；
2010年出現裂縫。
en: Falling groundwater in the Yamuna basin has raised structural concerns;
cracks appeared in 2010.

zh: 2018年與2020年的暴風雨也造成損害。
en: Storms in 2018 and 2020 caused damage as well.

zh: 修復人員用泥漿敷面讓大理石恢復白色，
並更換破損的石材。
en: Restorers apply mud packs to bring back the white
and replace broken marble.

zh: 會排放污染的車輛不能開到園區旁。
遊客從停車場步行，或改搭電動巴士進來。
en: Polluting vehicles may not drive up to the complex.
Visitors walk from the car parks or take electric buses.

zh: 保護一座建築，最後要照顧的，
是它周圍的河流與空氣。
en: Protecting a building, in the end,
means looking after the river and the air around it.

zh: 2023年12月27日的早晨，北印度的冬季大霧。
濃霧裡，泰姬瑪哈陵幾乎從視線裡消失。
en: The morning of 27 December 2023: north India's winter fog.
In the thick fog, the Taj Mahal all but disappeared from view.

zh: 那天早上，遊客從正門與黛安娜王妃長椅，
都很難看清楚陵墓。
en: That morning, visitors at the Royal Gate and the Lady Diana bench
could barely make out the tomb.

zh: 縮時：日出前的天色到太陽升起。
園區從日出前一小時開放，每週五休園。
en: Time-lapse: from the sky before dawn to sunrise.
The complex opens an hour before sunrise and is closed on Fridays.

zh: 盛夏的中午，月光花園一片明亮。
正對陵墓的這座花園，位在亞穆納河的氾濫平原上。
en: A midsummer noon: the Moonlight Garden lies in bright sun.
Facing the tomb, this garden sits on the Yamuna's flood plain.

zh: 傍晚，太陽沉向西方，白色轉成暖色。
園區在日落前四十五分鐘關門。
en: Evening: the sun sinks in the west and the white turns warm.
The complex closes 45 minutes before sunset.

zh: 只有滿月那一天，園區另有有限名額的夜間參觀，
齋戒月除外。
en: Only on the day of the full moon is there a limited night viewing,
except in the month of Ramadan.

zh: 亞穆納河右岸，還有一片七十公頃的綠帶：
泰姬自然步道。
en: On the right bank of the Yamuna lies a 70-hectare green belt:
the Taj Nature Walk.

zh: 步道全長約九公里，
沿途有多個眺望泰姬瑪哈陵的觀景點。
en: The trail runs for about nine kilometres,
with a string of viewpoints looking at the Taj Mahal.

zh: 園裡有四十六種以上的花，也有蝴蝶與鳥。
看得到的鳥包括鸚鵡與翠鳥。
en: More than 46 kinds of flowers grow here, with butterflies and birds:
parakeets and kingfishers among them.

zh: 紅領綠鸚鵡是少數適應了人為環境的鸚鵡；
在泰姬自然步道就看得到牠們。
en: The rose-ringed parakeet is one of the few parrots that have adapted to disturbed land;
they can be seen on the Taj Nature Walk.

zh: 步道上也可能遇見藍牛羚、胡狼與野兔。
en: Along the walk you may also meet blue bulls, jackals and hares.

zh: 藍牛羚是亞洲最大的羚羊。
成年的公羚毛色是帶藍的灰色。
en: The nilgai, or blue bull, is the largest antelope in Asia.
Adult males wear a bluish-grey coat.

zh: 1983年，它列入世界遺產，
被稱為「印度伊斯蘭藝術的瑰寶」。
en: In 1983 it was inscribed as World Heritage,
described as "the jewel of Islamic art in India".

zh: 2007年又名列「世界新七大奇蹟」；
一座為一個人而建的建築，留下來給所有人看。
en: In 2007 it was named one of the New 7 Wonders of the World:
a building made for one person, left for everyone to see.
